data.desc: Cracker Barrel Old Country Store, Inc. - rooted in a rich legacy of warmth, generosity, and tradition - is on a mission to bring the goodness of country hospitality to life. Since 1969, when the first store opened in Lebanon, Tenn., Cracker Barrel has been serving up abundant portions of craveable homestyle food and offering one-of-a-kind retail finds. With over 650 company-owned Cracker Barrel Old Country Store locations in 43 states, the brand continues to honor its heritage while welcoming everyone with more than a meal.
